articles.headline: Regional trade deficit widens sharply
articles.summary: AI summary: State Bank data show Pakistan's trade gap with nine neighbouring countries grew about 27pc to $4.97bn in July to September, as imports, mostly from China, climbed nearly 20pc while exports slipped about 7pc. The export fall was driven largely by a collapse in shipments to Afghanistan, where trade has been suspended since October 2025.
